theme_and_archetype.core_concept: A wealth club interface. Using deep absolute blacks, hyper-crisp 1px electric blue borders, and warm gold accents to create tension between cold technology and warm wealth.

rules.labels: font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-text-tertiary

surface_treatment.tracing_beam_active: relative overflow-hidden before:absolute before:inset-0 before:-z-10 before:p-[1px] before:bg-gradient-to-br before:from-brand before:to-transparent before:rounded-lg

styling_recipes.grain_overlay: after:content-[''] after:pointer-events-none after:absolute after:inset-0 after:bg-[url('/noise.png')] after:opacity-[0.03] after:mix-blend-overlay z-0

wallet_balance_hero.structure: Bento Grid - Main span. Generous padding (p-8)
wallet_balance_hero.styling: Card with `hero-gradient` applied. Top section: subtle 'Wallet Balance' mono label. Middle: Huge balance text `text-5xl sm:text-6xl font-heading tracking-tighter tabular-nums`. Bottom: Flex row for Deposit/Withdraw buttons.
wallet_balance_hero.buttons: Deposit: Solid brand background with text-white (no gold text on blue to maintain contrast). Withdraw: Outline/Ghost button with 1px border-border and text-text-primary hover:bg-surface-alt.

daily_claim_reward_card.structure: Compact card, highly prominent (Gold accent focus).
daily_claim_reward_card.styling: Dark mode: 1px solid gold border (`border-[#F5D061]/30`) with a very soft gold inner glow (`shadow-[inset_0_0_20px_var(--gold-soft)]`).
daily_claim_reward_card.content: Flex-col. Timer in mono font `tabular-nums tracking-widest text-gold`. Large 'Claim' button with solid gold background, black text. If claimed, disabled state with grayscale.

featured_investment_plan.styling: Image on top (max-h-40 object-cover rounded-t-lg), text below. Use high contrast. 1px solid border. Hover effect: slight lift (`-translate-y-1`) and border changes to `--brand`.
featured_investment_plan.metrics: Display metrics (Daily %, Days) in a 2-column grid with mono labels above large numeric values. Avoid standard bullet points.

quick_action_cards.structure: Grid of 2 to 3 small square cards.
quick_action_cards.styling: Flat background (`bg-surface`), `rounded-lg`, 1px border. Minimalist icons (Phosphor/Lucide) colored in `--brand`. Text should be heavily left-aligned.

admin_announcement_banner.structure: Full width thin strip above or below hero.
admin_announcement_banner.styling: Solid brand color (Royal Blue) background with white text, or pure black with gold text. Marquee or static centering. Close 'x' button on right.

navigation.mobile_bottom_nav: Glassmorphism background (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-surface/80`). Icons active state: Gold or Electric Blue. No labels if icons are extremely clear, or tiny text-xs.
navigation.desktop_sidebar: Solid `bg-app-bg`, right border `border-border/40`. Clean list of links. Active state: 1px left border in `--brand`, background `--brand-soft`.

implementation_notes.css_variables: Update `src/index.css` to replace the old indigo/pink/amber with the new exact hex codes provided in this JSON.
implementation_notes.fonts: Import Clash Display and IBM Plex Sans. In tailwind.config.js, map theme.fontFamily.heading to Clash Display and sans to IBM Plex Sans.
implementation_notes.spacing: Maintain generous spacing. Do not cram elements on mobile. Use `gap-4` to `gap-6` standard.
implementation_notes.component_borders: All cards should have `rounded-lg` (8px). Shadows should be minimal ambient or entirely replaced by crisp 1px borders to align with the 'Premium/Swiss' high-contrast aesthetic.
implementation_notes.anti_ai_rules_applied: No generic purple gradients. Center-aligned layouts are avoided in favor of strong left-alignment on data. Generous padding applied. Specific emotion (Luxury Fintech) targeted.
